mapper.insert: insert into ai_model_usage ( message_id, user_id, provider, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens ) values ( #{messageId}, #{userId}, #{provider}, #{model}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens} )
mapper.select: select model_usage.provider, model_usage.model, count(*) as request_count, case when count(model_usage.prompt_tokens) = count(*) then sum(model_usage.prompt_tokens) end as prompt_tokens, case when count(model_usage.completion_tokens) = count(*) then sum(model_usage.completion_tokens) end as completion_tokens, case when count(model_usage.total_tokens) = count(*) then sum(model_usage.total_tokens) end as total_tokens from ai_model_usage model_usage join users account on account.id = model_usage.user_id where account.school_id = #{schoolId} and model_usage.created_at >= now() - interval 24 hour group by model_usage.provider, model_usage.model order by total_tokens desc
